methodology: Hand-reviewed numerical transcription from SEBI-hosted issuer abridged RHP. Issuer-published restated consolidated information, not independently audited by Atlas; do not infer fair value or bidding recommendation.

riskFlags: The company reported losses in FY2024 and FY2025 before its FY2026 profit; sustained profitability is not assured.

Five of eight North India hospitals contributed 66.07% of FY2026 revenue from operations, creating geographic concentration.
The prospectus discloses a promoter-group member appearing in a CIBIL wilful-defaulter database; refer to the official risk factors for context.
